#define MAX_CAP_NUM 16
#define SPRD_FACE_BEAUTY_PARAM_NUM 10
#define ARRAY_LEN 9
#define HDR_IMG_NUM_MAX 16
#define XDR_MAX_FUSION_FRAME 3
#define SENSOR_NAME_LEN 32


struct iScene_info_t {
    struct version_param_t version_info;
    struct common_info_t common_info;
    struct switch_info_t switch_info;
    struct postproc_info_t postproc_info;
    struct cap_info_t cap_info;
    struct sensor_info_t sensor_info;
    struct custom_info_t custom_info;
    struct trigger_info_t trigger_info;
    struct pipeline_param_t pipeline_info;
};

struct version_param_t {
    float version;
    int date;
    int reserve0;
    int reserve1;
    int reserve2;
    int reserve3;
    int reserve4;
    float reserve5;
    float reserve6;
    float reserve7;
    float reserve8;
    float reserve9;
};

struct common_info_t {                          
    uint8_t session_mode;
    uint32_t frameID;

    uint32_t height;

    struct img_rect dcam_trim;
    bool isVideoFirstFrame;
    int32_t sprd_flash_lcd_mode;
    int32_t ae_mode;
    int32_t flash_mode;
    int32_t reserved0;
    int32_t reserved1;
    int32_t reserved2;
    int32_t reserved3;
    int32_t reserved4;
    int32_t reserved5;
    int32_t reserved6;
    int32_t reserved7;
    int32_t reserved8;
    int32_t reserved9[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    float reserved10;
    float reserved11;
    float reserved12;
    float reserved13;
    float reserved14;
    float reserved15[MAX_CAP_NUM];
};

struct zoom_info_t {
	float zoom_ratio;
	struct img_rect cropRegion;
};

struct img_rect {
	cmr_s32 start_x;
	cmr_s32 start_y;
	cmr_u32 width;
	cmr_u32 height;
};

struct watermark_param {
    int32_t wm_width;
    int32_t wm_height;
    int32_t text_size;    //0:small, 1:default, 2:large
    int32_t location;    //0:left, 1:center, 2:right
    int32_t mode;   //0:off, 1:common, 2:customer
    int32_t file_count;
};

    float reserved15[MAX_CAP_NUM];
};

struct usd_out_param_t {
    int face;    // 0:no face; 1:backlight face; 2:frontlight face; 3:sidelight face
    float fblt_c;   //  confidence of backlit face , value: (0~1)
    float prop_dark;   //  the proportion of dark areas in the scene
    float prop_bright;   //  the proportion of bright areas in the scene
    float reserved1;    // mean steepness of Y-channel histogram
    float reserved2;    // number of local peaks in the histogram
    float reserved3;    //  maximum distance of histogram peak value
    float reserved4;    //  pixel percentage near the peak of the histogram
    int chdr_flag;   //  1:need chdr processed; 0: not need processed; 99: this part closed
    int hdr_flag;   //  1:need hdr processed; 0: not need processed; 99: this part closed
    int mfnr_flag;   //  1:need mfnr processed; 0: not need processed; 99: this part closed
    int dark_flag;    //  1:dark scene; 0: not dark scene; 99: this part closed
    int solid_color;    //  1:solid color scene; 0: not solid color scene; 99: this part closed
    int dark_light;   //  1:dark light scene; 0: not dark light scene
    int dark_bulb;   //  1:dark bulb scene; 0: not dark bulb scene
    float solid_ratio;   //  the proportion of solid color in the scene
    int Hvalloc1;   //  the color of solid color scene,value:[0:1:360]
    int stable_flag;   //  0:phone very stable; 1:phone relatively stable;2: phone not stable
    int local_movement_flag;    // 1:obvious local motion; 0: no obvious local motion;2:not judge for local movement;99: this part closed
    float diff_ratio;   //  the proportion of difference pixels in adjacent frames
    int phone_posture;   //  1:dark light scene; 0: not dark light scene
    int in_out_flag;    //   0: outdoor; 1:between 0 and 2; 2:indoor; 3:very dark or night; 99: this part closed
    int light_value;    //  the environment light by the light sensor
    int lls_ready_flag;   //  1: lls scene cap ; 0: not lls scene cap
    int lls_cap_flag;   //  1:lls capture processing ; 0: not lls capture processing
    int flash_fired;   //  1:need flash; 0: not need flash
    int flash_lighting_mode;
    int dark_ACD_flag;   //  1:ACD dark scene; 0: ACD light scene
    bool ACD_m_GMotionfind;   //  true:global motion ; false: no global motion
    int ACD_m_MotionLevel;   //  1:local movement; 2: golbal movement; 3:fast local movement; 4:fast golbal movement; 0: stable scene;99: this part closed
    bool wfaceNsolid;   //  true:stable face in the scene; false:no stable face in the scene
};

struct cap_info_t {
    int jpegOrientation;

    int reserved0;

    float reserved7;
    float reserved8;
    float reserved9[MAX_CAP_NUM];
};
